notes: All 25 source and 26 target IDs partitioned exactly once.

ἡ πτῶσις αὐτῆς → *the fall thereof* keeps *the* on the article: *thereof* is a postnominal possessor and not a determiner, so rule 20's displacement does not reach it — the contrast with the prenominal possessives elsewhere in this chapter.
προσέκοψαν keeps its own verb word and the preposition over its dative object rides with the governed noun (rule 106), as at MAT.7.25.
The fronted predicate adjective takes a bare *great*, the copula being expressed so that rule 53 does not arise.
